Level A

Foundation: The Player Class

Build the core class that powers your character

What You'll Learn

1 Create a class with a constructor that sets up initial state
2 Define instance attributes to store data in objects
3 Write methods that operate on the object's own data
4 Implement defensive programming by clamping values within valid ranges

Key Terms

Term Definition
Constructor A special method automatically called when creating a new object
Instance Attribute A variable that belongs to a specific object instance
Method A function that belongs to a class and operates on object data
Parameter A value passed into a method when it is called
Return Value The output a method gives back to the caller
Clamping Restricting a value to stay within a minimum and maximum range

Class Design (UML)

- Private
+ Public
→ Returns

Structure Guide

Click each section to expand. Complete them in order — each builds on the previous.

1 Class Definition
CLASS Player:
Define the class. Everything inside belongs to this blueprint.
2 Constructor
CONSTRUCTOR(name):
Receives: the player's name

Must do:
  • Store the name as an attribute
  • Set health to 100
  • Set max_health to 100
  • Set armour to 2
  • Set accuracy to 85
Hint: Use self.attribute_name = value for each attribute.
3 get_status
METHOD get_status() → string:
Returns: a description of the player

Format: "Alice: 85/100 HP"
Include the name and current/max health.
4 take_damage
METHOD take_damage(amount):
Receives: amount of damage

Must do:
  • Subtract amount from health
  • Ensure health never goes below 0
Hint: If the result would be negative, set it to 0 instead.
5 heal
METHOD heal(amount):
Receives: amount to heal

Must do:
  • Add amount to health
  • Ensure health never exceeds max_health
Hint: If the result would exceed maximum, cap it there.

Station Map

View the Sigma-7 station layout. Fog of war reveals as you progress through levels.

Your Mission

Build the Player Class

You've woken up in the airlock of Sigma-7 Research Station. Before you can explore, the station's systems need to know who you are.

Download the project files and open student/player.py. Use the UML diagram and structure guide above to build your Player class.

When you're ready, run the validator to check your implementation.
